entries.test: Archived Anthropic pricing pages from April 21, 2026 would show whether Claude Code was removed from the listed benefits of the $20 Pro plan.
entries.note: The claim concerns pricing-page listings, not confirmed loss of access for every subscriber.

entries.test: Subsequent public pricing pages, support-document revisions, and announcements would establish another comparable change to Anthropic subscription entitlements.
entries.note: The source predicts recurrence, but does not explicitly restrict future changes to cuts or restrictions. No deadline is given.
“This suggests” presents changes across all tiers as a tentative inference. Avasare's statements are evidence for the inference, not a conditional antecedent.
The source says “likely” cost-cutting. The normalization adds an explicit causal explanation for enterprise repricing where the source states sequence and cost context.

entries.test: Contemporaneous support documents, pricing pages, and public evidence about the experiment's scope would establish whether the exclusion was displayed generally despite the stated 2% signup test.
entries.note: Zitron endorses the asserted discrepancy, not Anthropic's explanation. The claim includes a concrete factual assertion about what the documentation showed.
“Will likely” explicitly qualifies the prediction. The updated introduction reports reversal of the changes discussed in this retained passage.

entries.test: Contemporaneous captures of Anthropic's mobile and desktop pricing pages would show whether both omitted Claude Code from Pro-plan benefits.
entries.note: The later reversal does not negate the claim about what the pages previously displayed.
